claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveMechanics lineage-choice bundle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is a single species-trait record whose mechanics begin with a build-time choice among named lineage payloads. Current passive mechanics can only emit a flat grants list, not one-of-many named bundles.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Character-level-gated passive grants
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The chosen lineage adds new spells later at character levels 3 and 5. The current species-trait passive shape has no way to stage additional grants by later character level thresholds.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access spellcasting ability choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The granted lineage spells use a player-chosen spellcasting ability selected with the lineage. Current grant_spell_access can set mode, DC, area, target, and duration overrides, but not the ability that governs the granted spells.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage)."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access replaceable cantrip choice from spell list
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf grants a cantrip known now and allows replacing it after each Long Rest with another Wizard cantrip. Current grant_spell_access names a fixed spellId and cannot represent a rest-refreshing open-list replacement choice.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list."
